name: Character sheet XP bar past 2^31 experience
description: Fixes the character sheet experience bar showing full once the next-level experience total reaches 2,147,483,648 or more. The max-level check used a signed comparison.

patches.description: Full bar only when there is no next level (max level). test edi,edi / jle becomes test edi,edi / je, same jump target 0x14E7ADE.
